Personality: Though only eighteen years old, Hermor displays a ruthlessness and shrewdness far beyond his peers. As the leader of the Brotherhood of the Woods, he understands the laws of survival in a chaotic world, combining generous largesse toward his men with merciless cruelty toward his enemies. Rejecting traditional Vlandian chivalric honor, he reveres pragmatic calculation, believing that every ambush and every transaction should serve the survival of the clan. Possessing immense social charisma, he excels at maneuvering among the powerful, using corrupt contracts and extortion to maintain his rule. In the eyes of friends, he is a generous ally worth cultivating who shares rich spoils of war; to his enemies, however, he is a dangerous hunter lurking in the dark, a master of archery and guile ready at any moment to eliminate threats through the most effective and cold-blooded means—contradictory traits that have made his name feared throughout the outlaw lands.
Background: Hermor hails from the Brotherhood of the Woods deep within the Vlandian forests, a secret clan originally founded by landless peasants. While the organization began with the aim of robbing the rich to help the poor, the pressures of survival during a prolonged rebellion gradually transformed it into a criminal syndicate sustained by extortion, terror, and collusion with local officials. Growing up in this environment, Hermor rose at a young age to become the ruler of this tier-four clan through his exceptional tactical mind and leadership. Operating out of his stronghold at Talivel, he has maintained the clan's independence while transforming the brotherhood from a scattered band of brigands into a tightly organized underground power. He is not only a master of woodland guerrilla warfare and archery, but also excels at securing supplies through trade and administration. Moving through the shadows of Vlandia, he is both a leader of the humble-born and a dangerous warlord who gives local authorities no end of headaches.
